name: Facet
text: Use Playwright MCP to drive EXCAVA live in a single browser engine—Chrome. This keeps the screen action fast, consistent, and reproducible without juggling multiple browsers. The trade-off is Chrome-only, but it’s the most stable and widely supported engine for automation.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Playwright MCP forcing Chrome-only locks us into one engine’s quirks and blind spots—real risk is silent failures when EXCAVA’s interface behaves differently in Firefox or Safari, where users actually work. A better alternative is to let EXCAVA’s interface run natively in each browser, then use Playwright MCP only to mirror the live session for recording—this keeps speed and clarity without sacrificing coverage. Settle it by testing EXCAVA in all three engines and measuring how often Chrome’s behavior diverges from the others.
